observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black Dell all-in-one desktop with the Dell logo visible. The stand is attached, and ports are visible on the back right side.

Photo 1 shows the front of the same device with a dark, non-illuminated screen. The Dell logo is visible at the bottom center of the bezel. A small blue sticker (likely Intel) is on the bottom right corner.
Photo 2 is similar to photo 1, showing the front of the screen from a slightly different angle. The screen is off, and reflections are visible. The Dell logo and Intel sticker are again visible.
All photos show the same device from different angles. The background is a patterned wall with gold, black, and white. The device is placed on a wooden stool.
